title: Constructive Algebraic, Synchronization, and Pure-Integer Perron Certificates for the Lambda > 2.229206 Ternary Cap-Set Growth Lower Bound
abstract: We present CAPSET-F3-GROWTH-CERT-1.0, an independently reproducible, zero-floating-point verification engine and constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel auditing the finite-dimensional algebraic, combinatorial, rational-price, and pure-integer spectral mechanisms underlying ZeHua Lu's November 23, 2026 unrefereed preprint 'A Constructive Lower Bound for the Growth Constant of Ternary Cap Sets' (arXiv:2611.30110, Theorem 1.1: Lambda > 2.229206468135675727981404). Without claiming to formalize the randomized GL(b,2) binary-flag pivot tables of Appendix C or full 14-step outer dynamic programming over all 352 rows end-to-end, we build a four-mode exact verifier over Z, Q, and F_3 backed by 18 constructive Lean 4 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings). Across 16 canonical certificates (C01-C16), we certify (i) exact cap-set seeds in F_3^3 (9-point paraboloid) and F_3^4 (20-point Q^-(3,3) ovoid) plus Prop. 2.3 two-color slot axioms and scalar deletion lifting, (ii) Lemma 3.1 3-sunflower-free port-state conservation, Eq. (3.1)-(3.2) score synchronization, and Prop. 3.2/Example 3.3 parity companion-path exclusion, (iii) Sec. 5.1-5.2 zero-fiber pooling, exact 6-spoke and 11-spoke stars in F_3^4, F_3^5 (zero cross-lines), and all four Eq. (A.1) rational filling-price checks against Table 2's floored lower bounds at Round 0 (z=2) and Round 9, and (iv) Theorem 4.1 tilted-cone domination on verbatim Round 9 matrices (n=50 retained >= 16.36%, n=200 retained >= 64.02%) plus Appendix A.4's verbatim 28-digit Round 9 matrices P_0,P_1,P_2, exact Perron floor J_0 = 10029057595358243801843755621, strict tail dominance, and exact 1000th-power Eq. (A.6) integer bracket proving Lambda > 2.229206468135675727981404. All 16 certificates, 63 unit/forgery tests, and 37 SHA-256 hashes verify deterministically.
